reason: The patch changes `.topic-map h3` in app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss:182 from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`, altering the light-theme value from 20% to 50%. The same rule at app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss:321 keeps 20%/80%.
